name: vllm-rocm-halo-wheel
description: vLLM wheel built from AMD's ROCm/vllm `gfx11` branch (gfx1151-tuned kernels: W4A16 prefill BLOCK_N, GDN prefill shape-keyed config, unquantized-weight stride padding off the gfx11x 4096B cliff). Built on the pinned InferStation ROCm 7.15.0a20260719 multi-arch Halo base, packaged FROM-scratch (.whl + resolved ROCm/PyTorch constraints + source commit). Incremental via persistent ccache mount. Consumed by the default vllm-rocm-halo assembler. Parallel to the upstream-main vllm-rocm-halo-main; gfx11 trades DiffusionGemma for AMD's gfx1151 performance kernels and retains FusedMoE.tp_size so AWQ MoE loads without the RoutedExperts regression.
